description: Cheapest price per unit, best first: per GB/TB for storage and RAM, per GB of VRAM for GPUs, per battery, per ounce, per foot of cable and so on. category = a key from list_categories (e.g. 'storage', 'ram', 'gpus', 'Batteries', 'Coffee & tea'). Optional condition for eBay categories: new, used or refurb.

category.description: A category key exactly as list_categories returns it, e.g. 'gpus', 'storage' or 'Batteries'

condition.description: Listing condition for eBay categories: 'new', 'used', 'refurb' or 'any' (default)

limit.description: How many rows to return (integer, default shown in the schema), e.g. 5

name: price_per_unit
